description: Control for Codex case 1, revised in round 7: in a module-level function Python binds no `__class__`, and `__class__()` is the module's `from pytest import skip as __class__`; but an imported name that starts with `__` is never certain (Python binds and mangles such names on its own, in this version and the next): TG003 warns that it may skip `test_adds`, never FAIL. The real runner skips the test.
